messages:
julia: noticed weird quota numbers on Console > Quotas for org-C. usage shows 90% but billing logs show most tokens attributed to org-D. can someone eyeball? :confused:

omar: hmm could be telemetry aggregation bug or bad routing header. where did you see the billing attribution?

julia: billing stream in bigpipe: `billing.events` shows tenant_id: org-D for spikes at 10:03-10:10. console query (prefixed) shows `org=org-C` for same time range.

ben: do we have any proxy/fallback routing added last week? we merged route-fallback which proxies to internal/fastpath then to internal/fallback when capacity low. maybe header gets dropped on fallback.

julia: found traces: trace trc-44a links console request -> internal/gateway -> internal/fallback. snippet:```
GET /api/console/quotas?org=org-C headers: x-org: org-C, x-user: julia
--> internal/gateway forwarded: x-org: org-C
--> internal/fallback forwarded: x-org: null, x-tenant-id: org-D
```

omar: wow x-org dropped and fallback attached its own tenant header from cached session. root cause: forwarding path overwrites headers without preserving original.

ben: that explains: billing picks up tenant from downstream service header (x-tenant-id) and it was org-D, while console used request param org=org-C. mismatch. Bad.

ops: severity? any customer data exposed?

julia: looks like this only affects telemetry/billing attribution and quota UI numbers, not raw data rows. but could confuse customers and billing. We should treat as sev-2.

omar: short fix: update fallback proxy to preserve incoming x-org/x-tenant-id headers and avoid inserting cached session tenant into forwarded headers. Also add defensive check in billing pipeline: prefer explicit request-org param when present or trace tag fallback.

ben: I'll send a hotfix PR to gateway:https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/330 (preserve-tenant-headers). includes unit test to verify header passthrough and an integration test that simulates fallback.

julia: add monitor: `console.routing.header_mismatch` increment when request_org != forwarded_org and alert at >3/min. Also log trace id and both tenant values.

ops: rollback plan? we should disable route-fallback briefly while we patch to avoid further mis-attr. can we toggle?

ben: route-fallback is behind feature flag `routing.fallback.enabled`. toggling off will force fastpath or 503s. toggling off now to be safe.

console-bot: @ben requested toggle routing.fallback.enabled -> false. status: complete.

julia: confirmed reduced mismatch events after toggle off. will reopen once PR is deployed and monitors are green.

omar: also add a regression test in e2e that swaps tenant headers mid-flow to catch header overwrite races.

ben: noted. INF-2412 created for follow-ups: preserve headers, billing pipeline defensive check, alerting, e2e.

ops: recommend a short customer note if billing invoices touched by this window. tagging finance.

julia: thanks all. big win catching this before invoices go out. closing after e2e and rollout.
